image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a dark-colored firearm, specifically resembling an MP5 submachine gun or similar compact assault weapon. The image shows the receiver, pistol grip, trigger guard, magazine well with a ribbed magazine, and part of the barrel/handguard assembly against a plain white background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays the linear alignment of the receiver, grip, and forward assembly typical of this class of firearm.

The barrel extends out of frame to the left, and the muzzle device is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A rail system or carrying handle structure is visible along the top of the receiver.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the receiver, above the trigger group
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is faint, illegible marking/text on the receiver wall. It resembles serial number stamping or model designation but lacks clear character definition, appearing slightly melted or blurred, which is common in AI generations of text on objects.
The vertical ribs on the magazine are slightly inconsistent in spacing and depth, appearing somewhat soft rather than sharply machined.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of firearm (e.g., MP5 vs generic assault rifle) and verify class alignment.
To check for structural continuity between the receiver, grip, and magazine, ensuring no floating parts or fusion errors.
To analyze the illegible markings on the receiver to determine if they are valid alphanumeric characters or AI gibberish.
To assess general sharpness, lighting consistency, and material rendering quality.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the magazine well connection
Clarity and validity of receiver markings/text
Consistency of mechanical details (trigger, safety selector)
Edge sharpness between firearm and background
